fields.title: Facebook video record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of one video per row. One VIDEO row per reel or video, one RUN_SUMMARY per run, ERROR rows when a tab or video cannot be read. Facebook changes its payload without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The page tab or video id this record came from.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: tab_unavailable, video_unavailable or unexpected_error.

videoId.title: Video ID
videoId.description: Facebook's numeric id for the video or reel.

permalinkUrl.title: Permalink
permalinkUrl.description: Canonical URL of the reel or video.

isReel.title: Is a reel
isReel.description: True when the permalink is a /reel/ URL.

pageId.title: Page ID
pageId.description: Numeric id of the publishing page.

title.title: Video title
title.description: The video's own title, where one was set.

caption.title: Post caption
caption.description: The text the page published with the video.

playCount.title: Plays
playCount.description: Play count. Exact on the videos tab; on the reels tab Facebook only publishes an abbreviation ('292K'), which is parsed to 292000 - read it together with playCountLabel.

playCountLabel.title: Plays (as shown)
playCountLabel.description: Exactly what Facebook rendered, so an approximation is never mistaken for an exact figure.

commentCount.title: Comments
commentCount.description: Comment count on the video's post.

shareCount.title: Shares
shareCount.description: Share count, where Facebook reports one.

engagementTotal.title: Engagement
engagementTotal.description: Reactions + comments + shares, over whichever of those Facebook published.

engagementRatePercent.title: Engagement rate (%)
engagementRatePercent.description: engagementTotal as a percentage of plays. Null when the play count is unknown or zero - never computed against a placeholder.

width.title: Width
width.description: Pixel width of the playback video.

height.title: Height
height.description: Pixel height of the playback video.

trackTitle.title: Audio track
trackTitle.description: Name of the music track, where the reel uses one.

isOriginalAudio.title: Original audio
isOriginalAudio.description: Whether the reel's audio is the creator's own.

videoHdUrl.title: Video URL (HD)
videoHdUrl.description: Direct MP4. A signed CDN link that expires - download during or shortly after the run.

hasCaptions.title: Has captions
hasCaptions.description: Whether Facebook published a caption file for this video.

captionsUrl.title: Captions URL
captionsUrl.description: Signed link to the .srt caption file.

captionLocales.title: Caption languages
captionLocales.description: Other caption tracks, with how each was created (e.g. automatic translation).

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.description: The spoken words, parsed from Facebook's caption file. Null when the video has no captions - this actor does not run speech recognition of its own.

transcriptSource.title: Transcript source
transcriptSource.description: Where the transcript came from, e.g. facebook-captions or the locale's creation method.

sourceTab.title: Source tab
sourceTab.description: reels, videos, or direct when the video was passed by URL.

overview.title: Videos
overview.description: One row per video: what it is, how it performed.

performance.title: Performance
performance.description: Sort by plays or engagement rate to find what worked.

transcripts.title: Transcripts
transcripts.description: The spoken text of every captioned video.
